description: This file defines the MediaBlobContainerTenantEvents class, which manages Azure Blob Storage container creation and deletion during tenant activation and removal in OrchardCore, including handling blob deletion within a specified base path.

classes.name: MediaBlobContainerTenantEvents
classes.description: Handles Azure Blob Storage container creation and deletion during tenant lifecycle events, including blob cleanup within a specified path.

methods.name: MediaBlobContainerTenantEvents
methods.description: Constructor initializing options, shell settings, localizer, and logger.

methods.name: ActivatingAsync
methods.description: Creates the Azure Blob container if it does not exist, during tenant activation.

methods.name: RemovingAsync
methods.description: Removes the container or blobs within a base path during tenant removal, with error handling.
